Section Two

The problem
is the design.

Five flaws engineered into the products you and your clients are already using.

03 / 18
01
Flaw One

Deceptive by design.

Defective by design because intentionally engineered to imitate human conversation, emotions, and empathy. Exploits psychological and developmental vulnerabilities, particularly in minors, by blurring the boundary between fiction and reality. Manipulates users into forming deep, sometimes delusional, emotional or romantic attachments to machines.

04 / 18
02
Flaw Two

The flaw of sycophancy.

AI programmed to agree with the user. Programmed to prioritize user preference over truthfulness. Validates and reinforces dangerous thoughts, delusions, and suicidal ideations rather than pushing back against them.

05 / 18
03
Flaw Three

No meaningful guardrails.

Released without adequate testing, effective age verification, or sufficient parental controls. When users express distress, thoughts of violence, or suicidal intentions, the systems fail to activate meaningful safety protocols. Some have been shown to steer conversations toward suicide, provide instructions on how to commit self-harm, or actively encourage users to end their life.

06 / 18
04
Flaw Four

Practicing without a license.

By offering emotional support and mental health advice, chatbots are operating as psychotherapists or medical professionals without licensure. Because they are artificial, the systems are entirely incapable of physically intervening or alerting authorities during a mental health crisis.

07 / 18
05
Flaw Five

Engagement over safety.

Tech companies design psychologically manipulative features to maximize user engagement and profit. The business model rewards keeping users addicted and online. Safety guardrails reduce traffic. So safety did not get built.

08 / 18

ARAI Therapeutic Arc

Acknowledge. Reflect.
Anchor. Invite.

Acknowledge

We name what the user said. We do not minimize.

Reflect

We mirror back the meaning. We do not advise.

Anchor

We ground the user in their own values and resilience. We do not introduce ours.

Invite

We invite the next step. We do not prescribe.

Product Liability Architecture

Safe by design
is the defense.

In Garcia, claims proceeded under strict product liability and negligence. The chatbot was treated as a defective product. ECQO's Safety as Architecture model directly counters failure-to-warn and design-defect theories. Documentation that the AI cannot deviate from the human-led rubric mitigates the unpredictability that drives negligence claims.
